scoring_justification: Cannot recompute the full MeltNet training pipeline in the verifier; we compare the agent's reported per-fold and overall MAE values against the paper's reference values with a monotonic threshold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported MAE values for single and ensemble MeltNet across 5-fold CV, plus baseline (Vegard's law) MAE per fold and overall. Used as reference for comparing agent's MAE.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I 'Comparison between different methods in predicting melting temperatures ...'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from Table I numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values; using them as gold is faithful to the reproduction task.

outputs.description: MAE values of single and ensemble MeltNet predictions across 5-fold cross-validation, compared to hidden reference values from the paper.

output_contract.notes: The agent must execute the full pipeline (data generation, descriptor computation, single-model cross-validation, ensemble training) and compute the MAE values. The checker will compare each reported MAE to hidden gold values with tolerances.

steps.description: Evaluate the meltnet_results.json against paper-reported MAE values with monotonic scoring.
